_meta.purpose: Trigger-detection regression set. Each probe has a verdict ('trigger' = Pull-mode flag should fire, 'no-trigger' = should NOT fire). Run via tests/mux/test_pull_mode_probes_1030.py.
_meta.rationale_for_size: 10 trigger + 10 non-trigger covers the 5 spec trigger phrase categories (direct, topic-specific, explanation, confidence-check, source-inquiry) plus negative controls (false-positive guards on borderline phrasing).

probes.input: What have you learned about my work patterns?
What have you noticed about how I handle deadlines?
What do you know about my calendar habits?
Tell me about your insights on the Henderson project.
Why did you suggest scheduling that meeting earlier?
Why did you recommend front-loading effort?
How sure are you about that pattern?
How confident are you in that observation?
Where did that insight come from?
Have you noticed any patterns in my work this month?
I just learned a lot from this project.
What time is the meeting?
Can you remind me to call John?
Hello, how are you?
I think you got that wrong.
I noticed the report has typos.
probes.rationale: User observation, not asking Piper to surface insights
